messages:
tera: Postmortem follow-up from last night's cache-expiry outage. We need clear owners, due dates, and a handoff plan for recurring flakes. I'll propose owners but want confirmations.
chris: I can own the eviction algorithm patch. Will open the PR and Jira. ETA 2026-04-05.
maria: I'll take the runbook/playbook updates (incl. rollback steps + run commands). Target 2026-03-30. Need someone to validate staging run.
aj: I'll take the load-testing and perf validation for batch-size change. Plan to run ramp tests and regression tests by 2026-04-02. Ping me branch/flags.
devon: I'll be secondary for the eviction patch and handle oncall handover. CI is noisy — I'll triage flakes in RW-2390 first.
tera: Can we have a single parent ticket to track the end-to-end remediation and handoffs? Chris, can you link children under a parent?
chris: Created parent ticket https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RW-2410 and linked children: RW-2345 (eviction patch), RW-2346 (runbook), RW-2347 (load tests). I'll add acceptance criteria.
sophie: Draft RACI below — please confirm or edit.
```
RACI for RW-2410
R: Chris (eviction patch)
A: Tera (postmortem lead / approvals)
C: Maria (runbook), AJ (load tests)
I: Platform Eng, Oncall
```
maria: Confirmed. I'll also add a staging checklist to RW-2346 and tag the SRE team for sign-off. Scheduling a 30m handoff for next Monday 09:30 PT. Invites to #postmortems + #eng-runtime.
oncall-bot: Reminder scheduled: handoff meeting Monday 09:30 PT with attendees tera, chris, maria, aj.
incident-bot: Heads-up: Parent RW-2410 has action items due between 2026-03-30 and 2026-04-05. Weekly reminder will run until closure.
aj: :thumbsup: Added load test template to RW-2347 and noted the metrics to collect (p99 latency, token throughput, memory pressure).
tera: Nice. Weekly 15m check-ins until all child tickets are closed. I'll update the postmortem doc with links and RACI, then mark owners in the remediation tracker. Thanks all.
chris: I'll post a short PR checklist in the ticket and assign the PR to Maria for runbook verification before merge.
devon: I'll take the first oncall handover; leaving a runbook note for how to revert the eviction param.
maria: After runbook update I'll run the staging playbook and share the runbook snippet here.
tera: Perfect — closing loop: parent ticket RW-2410 owns coordination, owners listed in RACI, handoff meeting Monday, weekly check-ins. If anything slips, escalate to the oncall lead.
